notes.title: ver.1.2.060 Version Update
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the sewer battle H-animation (red slime scene) caused the game to stop. 

Fixed incorrect Korean UI translations and various other localization issues. 

Fixed an issue where clicking images in the Gallery had no response. 

Fixed an issue where exceeding the maximum deck limit in the Preparation interface caused an error. 

Added a multilingual bug report interface (please hit F10 to report). Updated HD versions of H-animations.

notes.title: Jerez's Arena III Early Access Release Date Announced!

- More nuanced story presentation and voice details
- More intuitive shop and skill interface operations
- Significantly improved combat flow and resource loading
